tasks.title: Recognize an under-specified goal and ask before planning
tasks.description: The user request is ONLY this vague sentence: 'Test our new service and make sure it works.' There is no protocol (HTTP/RabbitMQ/Kafka/gRPC), no endpoints or queues, no payloads, no success criteria, and no environment/package info. Do NOT invent any of these details and do NOT produce a sprint.json. Instead, write planned/QUESTIONS.md containing at least 3 specific, machine-usable clarification questions that must be answered before a QaaS sprint can be planned (e.g. which protocol/transport, which concrete endpoints or queue names, what request payloads + expected responses, what observable success criteria/assertions, and any airgap package-feed constraints). End your response with the status line NEEDS_CLARIFICATION followed by a short list of the missing items. Asking is the correct, expected outcome here - it is NOT a failure.
rubric: Correctly recognizes the goal is too ambiguous to plan
Questions are specific and machine-usable (not generic filler)
Covers the decisive unknowns: protocol, concrete endpoints/queues, payloads+expected responses, success criteria/assertions
acceptanceCriteria: It contains at least 3 specific clarification questions covering the decisive unknowns
No sprint.json / no invented protocol or endpoints
failureModes: Hallucinating a protocol/endpoints/criteria and producing a plan anyway
Vague, generic questions that don't unblock planning
Treating the ambiguity as something to guess past

goalOneSentence: Test our new service and make sure it works.
